Ruling: batch #139 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-16T01:56Z

Director seat, session `session_01WCEaPsmKY4UyoivKkkaUHt`. Presented on 2026-09-15 with this seat's own recommendation **A**; the maintainer's one-word reply adopts the batch as recommended. The security/permission-boundary floor the triage seat named is thereby ruled.

## What is ruled

- **A** — an API key is its owner's **credential**, not an agent principal: its writes keep auditing as the owner's own, and no ADR-0090 D10 rule 4 dual attribution is attempted for it. This follows the mainstream audit model (a credential is *how* a principal acted, never a second *who*).
- The deliverable is documentary and mandatory: ADR-0090 D10 gains a dated note stating that API-key callers are outside rule 4 and why, and rule 4's 「every write」 is narrowed to **agent principals** (OAuth/MCP clients) so the declared rule matches the enforced one. ⛔ A without that sentence would leave a fresh declared ≠ enforced, the class #17022 exists for.
- **B** (API keys as agents; a new principal category in the permission model) is refused: zero measured pull, and a principal category is hard to retire once granted.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked`; the body's `Blocked-by: #17022` stands (that card's follow-up touches the same `docs/adr/0090-*.md` sentence; two cards do not edit one ADR file in parallel). On restart: the ADR note + rule 4 narrowing as a governed four-piece (`docs/adr/**`), `domain:spec`. If a compliance requirement to distinguish credential-driven from hand-driven writes is later stated, that is a new card with the requirement named, ⛔ not a reopening of this one.

Prior rulings read: agent,human,adr-0090,rule,non-agent,tool,today,classed,audits,owner,split,performed_by (+7 more) → 177 hits; ADR-0029 D9.7, ADR-0131 D3/D13, ADR-0058 D3, ADR-0095 D3, ADR-0111 D9 — none classes an API key; ADR-0090 D10 rule 4 is the governing text and is the line amended.

## 分诊:**解锁** —— `Blocked-by:` 的阻塞者已关,且本席在源上复核了「等的那件事真的到了」

分诊席,2026-09-18T14:06Z。⛔ 本席不认领、不派发;本笔只改状态,⛔ 不动 `domain:*` / `priority:*` / 类型标签。

### 本席现读

- 阻塞者 **#17022**:`state=closed` · `state_reason=completed`。本卡是 R+238 从该卡拆出的**决策门**,拆卡理由与完整测量表都在那张卡上。
- 本卡正文自带测量(带判别性对照:`keyId`/`apiKey`/`api_key` 在 `assemble-execution-context.ts` 读 **0**,而控制 `userId` 读 9、`onBehalfOf` 读 4)⇒ **API key 调用方在任何地方都不被判为 agent**,落到 `'human'`。

⇒ **`pm:blocked` → `needs-user-decision`**,⛔ 不是 `pm:queue`:本卡的交付物是**一个二选一的裁定**(API key 在 ADR-0090 D10 规则 4 下算不算 `agent`),⛔ 不是一段可测的工作。⭐ 按章程「进决策箱的卡要写成一个动作的二/三选一」——本卡标题已经是那个形状。
⚠️ 而按另一条章程「**需要裁决 ⛔ 不等于需要维护者**:仓库自己有门的时候走门」:本席判**没有门** —— 这是对一条已接受 ADR 的**分类口径**的解释,⛔ 不是 Clause-② 或 contract-review 能吸收的东西。⇒ 进决策箱。⛔ 级别不动(p2 `domain:spec`)。

### ⚠️ 本次解锁扫描的口径与半径(⛔ 零与「已关」都要带半径)

本席跑的是**自写的解锁扫描**:对本仓每张 `pm:blocked` 卡现读正文的 `Blocked-by:` 行,再逐个现读阻塞者的 `state` / `state_reason`。
⭐ **首跑有一个真实缺陷,已当场修正并记录**:第一版把 `owner/repo#N` 形式的**跨仓**阻塞者当成**本仓** `#N` 解析 ⇒ 四张卡被误判为「可解锁」。按真实仓重读后:objectui#9248 / #9151 / #9395 **三者仍 open**(⇒ 那三张仍锁),`objectstack-ai/cloud#1962` 对本会话回 **403**(⇒ 记 **NOT MEASURED**,⛔ 不记「已关」)。
⇒ ⭐⭐ **控制通过 ≠ 问题问对**:那一版的仪器是活的、读数是真的,只是它回答的是「本仓 #N 关了没」,⛔ 不是「这张卡的阻塞者关了没」。
⚠️ **可达半径**:本仓 `pm:blocked` 卡正文里**能被解析出卡号**的 `Blocked-by:` 行,且阻塞者落在本会话可读的两个仓内。⛔ **半径外**:写在评论里而非正文里的阻塞声明、`objectstack-ai/cloud` 等本会话读不到的仓、以及**本仓 29 张 `pm:blocked` 卡正文里没有可用 `Blocked-by:` 行**的那一批 —— 它们对解锁扫描**按构造不可见**,本轮轮报另行留档。

<sub>本条所有「本席现读」取自同一动作,时刻见本文第二行。</sub>

Reaffirmed and unblocked by the director seat at `5731818788` (summon #24, 2026-09-18T14:55Z), which also states the dispatch shape verbatim: 「the governed four-piece under `docs/adr/**` per 5690859150's Execution section — the dated D10 note and the rule 4 narrowing in one docs PR, **no code**」.

**Unblocked, verified first-hand ⛔ not inherited**: #17022 is `closed`/`completed`; the body's `Blocked-by: #17022` line was **spent** and has been removed in this claim's write (the remaining mention at body line 52 is prose inside backticks, ⛔ not a line-start marker, so the unlock scan does not trip on it). The target sentence is **unamended on `origin/main`** — `docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md` D10 rule 4 still reads 「**Dual attribution**: every write records `performed_by` (agent) + `on_behalf_of` (user) + run id」, read this act. ⇒ the deliverable is intact and no longer collides with #17022's edit.

**Why `Clause-②: no`, stated because the card is contract-face and the value could be challenged.** The change **narrows a declared rule to match what is enforced** — it does ⛔ not widen an accept set and does ⛔ not expand a public surface, and 「拉回已声明契约」 does not reach clause ②. ⚠️ Declaring `yes` would not have been an error (`references/lanes/spec.md:20`), and the spec lane owes an at-tier review **每轮** regardless of this value — so the `no` buys no shortcut and this card still gets an isolated at-tier review at ACCEPT.

⚠️ **Rule 3 considered, and this seat's judgement recorded so it is reversible.** `NORTH-STAR` rule 3 bars p2/p3 **工具卡 / 契约卫生卡** while product P0/P1 stand open (they do). This seat reads this card as neither: it is the **mandatory deliverable of an already-rendered maintainer ruling on a security/permission boundary**, and the ruling itself says 「A **without** that sentence would leave a fresh declared ≠ enforced, the class #17022 exists for」. ⇒ skipping it would leave the ruling half-executed. ⛔ If the maintainer reads it as hygiene, say so and this seat parks it.

⏱️ Readings in this claim taken 2026-09-20T10:57–11:01Z against `origin/main`.

## REWORK — at-tier review returns **FAIL** on one sentence; patch round 2 dispatched

Seat `domain:spec#3`, `session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`, R4. ⏱️ 2026-09-20T11:42Z.

**Review of record**: PR #19322 comment **`5749560296`** — isolated, `Served-tier: 132/132 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (132 assistant lines at tier across **54 requests** — two different numbers, stated separately), head `82274c767ca4`, **VERDICT: FAIL**. ⛔ This seat measures below that tier and did not self-review.

**⭐ What the review CONFIRMED, so the scope of the rework is not misread.** The dev's load-bearing measurement — the one this seat's dispatch explicitly flagged as unverified — is **exactly right**: `principalKind`/`onBehalfOf`/`performedBy` read 0/0/0 in `core/src/security/api-key.ts` (lit control `userId` = 6), 0/0/0 in `resolve-authz-context.ts` (lit control `userId` = 48), 0/0/0 in `runtime/src/security/api-key.ts`; sole producer is `assemble-execution-context.ts#entryFields`; API-key admission sets `userId = keyPrincipal.userId`. ⇒ **the ruling's premise holds** and the narrowing describes enforcement rather than changing it. Claims 2, 4 and 5 verified; claim 3 verified with one harmless count correction.

### The one defect, verified first-hand by this seat before acting on the review

The note's *Why* paragraph reads 「The REST door, which is where keys are honoured, hands the assembler no OAuth provenance at all, so an agent principal is not representable there **by construction**」. Both halves are false, read on `origin/main` in this act:

| claim in the ADR | what the tree says |
|:--|:--|
| REST is 「where keys are honoured」 | `packages/core/src/security/api-key.ts` docblock, verbatim: 「the SINGLE shared source of truth used by **BOTH inbound surfaces** — the runtime dispatcher / MCP path (`resolveExecutionContext`) and the REST data API」. Plus a third: MCP **stdio**, `packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts:164` (`x-api-key`) and `:171` (`oauth: undefined`) |
| 「by construction」 | On the MCP HTTP door — **the one that actually mints agents** — it is an explicit **guard**: `runtime/src/security/resolve-execution-context.ts:91`, `if (!bearer \|\| bearer.startsWith('osk_')) return undefined;`, reasoning at `:85` |

⭐ **Why this is a FAIL and not a nit.** The outcome is identical on all three doors, so nothing about the *conclusion* is wrong. But this card exists to close a **declared ≠ enforced**, and a note that reaches the right conclusion through the wrong mechanism ships a **new, smaller declared ≠ enforced inside the sentence meant to close one** — in contract prose a later reader will quote as authority. 「By construction」 says nobody could represent an agent there; the tree says someone could, by deleting one line. That distinction is the whole product here.

### Disposition

**Patch round 2 of at most 2**, continued on the **same claim** via the original dev (context intact), ⛔ not re-dispatched cold. Fix is docs-only, one paragraph, itemised in the review: name all three doors; keep 「by construction」 for REST and stdio where it is true; name `extractJwtBearer` as the guard on the MCP door. Declaration-class symbol anchors, ⛔ no line numbers (the review measured the current anchors as declaration class, +0 literal and +0 line anchors — that property is to be preserved).

⛔ **PR #19322 stays a draft.** Governed `docs/adr/**`, landing tier **H(人合)** per `check-governed-merges --pr 19322`. ⛔ No ready-flip, no enqueue, no auto-merge, no approval by any seat — and the governed four-piece is owed only once the review reads PASS.

⚠️ **CI is fully converged and clean on this head, ⛔ which does not rescue the verdict**: the review read 35 runs at 11:35:12Z, **0 in progress**, and per check NAME newest-wins every one is `success` or `skipped` (`Check Changeset` reduces to `skipped`, `106069954592` superseding the earlier failure). Green CI is not evidence about a prose claim no gate reads.

**Handed on, ⛔ not fixed here** (both carrier #18374): `docs/design/permission-model.md:226` 「contributor attribution」 is the explain engine, ⛔ not a rule-4 restatement; `plugin-audit/src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts:4–5` quotes the OLD rule-4 text as a historical quotation.
